en_title: CD Projekt Releases Official List of All the Improvements in The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Remastered
subtitle: 技能树全面重做
opus_summary: CD Projekt公布《巫师3：狂猎》复刻版改进清单，涵盖画面、战斗、游玩便利性等方面，技能树也已重做。游戏将于9月29日作为免费更新推出，Switch 2版支持体感操作、陀螺仪瞄准和触屏操作。

paragraphs.en: CD Projekt has released an official list of all the improvements made for The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Remastered .
paragraphs.cn: CD Projekt公布了《巫师3：狂猎》复刻版的官方改进清单。

paragraphs.en: The developer issued media with the updated list, which breaks the improvements down into four categories: visual, combat, quality of life, and miscellaneous. We’ve reproduced them below so you know what to expect when the game launches tomorrow, September 29.
paragraphs.cn: 开发商向媒体提供了更新后的清单，将改进分为画面、战斗、游玩便利性和其他四类。我们在下文列出了这些内容，方便大家了解游戏明天，也就是9月29日推出时会有哪些变化。

paragraphs.en: We’ve also got the official The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Remastered global release times , so you know when the game unlocks in your region, as well as the update download sizes so you can best prepare.
paragraphs.cn: 我们还拿到了《巫师3：狂猎》复刻版的官方全球解锁时间，以及更新文件的下载大小，方便大家确认当地的解锁时间并提前做好准备。

paragraphs.en: “A lot has changed in the gaming world since The Witcher 3 first launched,” CD Projekt said in its note to the media. “We’ve continued to develop and improve the game over the years, with the last major update bringing the title to next-gen consoles. Never before, however, have we introduced so many extensive, far-reaching changes at once — Remastered is the first release of its kind for The Witcher 3.
paragraphs.cn: CD Projekt在发给媒体的说明中表示：「自《巫师3》首次推出以来，游戏界发生了很大变化。多年来，我们一直在开发和改进这款游戏，上一次大型更新还让它登陆了次世代主机。但我们从未一次性加入过如此多涉及面广、影响深远的改动。对《巫师3》而言，复刻版是首次推出这样的版本。」

paragraphs.en: “These changes affect every aspect of the game, with particular attention to exploration and combat mechanics. We’ve significantly improved a wide range of gameplay elements. Some features, such as the skill tree, have even been entirely rebuilt to ensure the best possible experience for both new and returning players. Whether this is your first time visiting the Continent or a long-awaited return to the Path, The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Remastered was created with you in mind.”
paragraphs.cn: 「这些改动涉及游戏的方方面面，尤其着重于探索和战斗机制。我们大幅改进了许多玩法要素，甚至彻底重做了技能树等功能，希望为新老玩家都带来尽可能好的体验。无论你是初次踏上大陆，还是期待已久、准备重返猎魔之路，《巫师3：狂猎》复刻版都考虑到了你的需求。」

paragraphs.en: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Remastered improvements:
paragraphs.cn: 《巫师3：狂猎》复刻版的改进内容如下：

paragraphs.en: From the sun-drenched hills of Beauclair to the snow-capped mountains of Skellige, the Continent has never looked so stunning. The world of The Witcher 3 is now more detailed than ever thanks to a range of visual improvements, while modernized lighting lets every location truly shine.
paragraphs.cn: 从阳光照耀的鲍克兰山丘，到白雪覆盖的史凯利格山脉，大陆的景色从未如此惊艳。一系列画面改进让《巫师3》的世界呈现出更多细节，升级后的光照也让各处场景更加出彩。

paragraphs.en: Overhauled combat feels modern, engaging, and more responsive than ever, and the skill tree—the heart of every RPG — has been rebuilt to radically improve player experience.
paragraphs.cn: 经过全面调整，战斗体验更符合现代玩家的习惯，也更有吸引力，操作响应比以往更加灵敏。作为RPG核心要素的技能树也已重做，以大幅改善玩家体验。

paragraphs.en: Revamped movement animations, more engaging exploration, and a range of other gameplay enhancements make every adventure even more immersive than before.
paragraphs.cn: 重新制作的移动动画、更吸引人的探索体验，以及其他一系列玩法改进，让每次冒险都比以往更有沉浸感。

paragraphs.en: As part of Remastered, we’ve also introduced a range of other additions to The Witcher 3 that are worth highlighting. While they don’t fall under any one specific aspect of the game, they still represent significant additions to the overall experience.
paragraphs.cn: 复刻版还为《巫师3》加入了一系列值得一提的新内容。这些内容虽然无法归入游戏的某个特定方面，但仍显著丰富了整体体验。

paragraphs.en: As for the Nintendo Switch 2 version, CD Projekt pointed to motion controls, which let players cast witcher Signs, fire the crossbow, throw bombs, drink potions, and speed up or stop Roach. Gyro aiming "offers greater precision in combat," while mouse mode gives players another control option. The touchscreen can be used to navigate the map or game menus, and play Gwent.
paragraphs.cn: 谈到任天堂Switch 2版，CD Projekt特别提到了体感操作：玩家可以用它施放猎魔人法印、发射弩箭、投掷炸弹、饮用药剂，以及让萝卜加速或停下。陀螺仪瞄准「能让战斗中的瞄准更加精准」，鼠标模式则提供了另一种操作方式。玩家还可以用触屏浏览地图或游戏菜单，以及游玩昆特牌。

paragraphs.en: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Remastered is available as a free update on PC, PS5, Xbox Series X|S, and Nintendo Switch 2 from September 29. To ease you into Geralt’s life on the road, check out the Things the Witcher 3 Doesn’t Tell You , plus IGN’s The Witcher 3 Walkthrough and The Witcher 3 Endings guide, which outlines all of the major quests and choices in the base game and expansions (now bundled in with the Remastered edition). When you’re ready for the tough choices, check out our The Witcher 3 Sex and Romance guide to see who Geralt can smooch and all the opportunities to do so. And to make Geralt as strong a monster hunter as possible, check out all the Witcher Gear Locations , Places of Power Locations , and even Gwent Card Locations .
paragraphs.cn: 《巫师3：狂猎》复刻版将于9月29日起在PC、PS5、XBOX Series和Switch 2平台作为免费更新推出。
